topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe I just found my childhood teddy at some stranger’s yard sale. Out of all the places, here he is, sitting on a dusty table like he’s just another piece of junk. He's not supposed to be here. He’s mine. I had a right to him, not these people. How did he even get here? I should've been the one to decide his fate, not end up in this pathetic little setup with a price tag. I snatched him up, paid the old woman, and left without a word. I won’t let anyone else take him ever again.
